==About==

{{i|Garlic Stuffed Mushrooms}} must be cooked over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}. '''NOTE:''' Remember to boil your Mushrooms to reduce {{i|'Shroom Poisoning}}.
